Issuer: the Connecticut Department of Motor Vehicles issues driver licenses and publishes the Connecticut Driver’s Manual [A03].
Edition: the imprint page prints the edition line “Revised March 2023” [A03]; no effective date is printed, so the effective date stays unconfirmed (verify — sec05-A-EFFECTIVE-DATE).
Exam path: a first time applicant passes a vision test and a 25-question knowledge test to earn a learner permit [A07], then a road test for the license [A09].
Scoring: the knowledge test spans 25 questions with 20 correct answers needed to pass [A07]; the manual states no time limit, which stays unknown (verify — sec05-A-TIME-LIMIT).
Question format: beyond samples on the DMV mobile app, the manual does not describe the item format of the knowledge test (verify — sec05-A-FORMAT).
Section link: this dossier section covers following trucks, space cushions ahead, behind and aside, blind spots, trouble spots, lane changes, passing, turning, backing and visibility, all drawn from the manual the test is built on [A23].
Practice mastery targets in this product are product policy from the accepted learning loop, never an official passing line.
Dynamic facts (updatable): fines, penalties and program referrals are set by law and can change between editions, so they are kept out of stable knowledge [A23]; why_dynamic: administrative details outside the printed rules of the road.
